title: Octagon

inlines.v: OC'TAGON, noun [Gr. eight and angle.] 1. In geometry, a figure of eight sides and eight angles. When the sides and angles are equal, it is a regular octagon which may be inscribed in a circle. 2. In fortification, a place with eight bastions.
